purpose: Feasibility pilot of exactly one future intervention on independently verified synthetic tasks; not a powered model or harness superiority claim.

model.resolution: Only after explicit user approval; do not query catalogs or infer an identifier.

intervention.permitted_selection: Choose and preregister one policy intervention; do not combine context elision, plan prompt and tool scheduling changes.

pairing.reset: Fresh identical workspace snapshot and isolated host journal/output store per arm. Never reuse mutated workspace or final plan. Record cache preconditioning and all warming costs; do not describe fresh chat IDs as proven cold provider caches.

model_visible_projection.workspace: Copy only the selected case workspace/ subtree. Initialize an isolated Git repository if the harness requires one. Oracles, controls, manifest, receipts and task.json are outside agent-readable paths.
model_visible_projection.messages: Project only api_contract, earlier_messages and latest_user_request; host-only recipe/answer/control fields must not be sent as task metadata. User history must retain roles and temporal order.
model_visible_projection.buried_failed_tests: Expand tool_observation_recipe byte-for-byte, admit through a valid settled call/result envelope and record the full observation hash. A future policy may transform it; do not pre-delete the decisive line from both arms.
model_visible_projection.output_recovery: Expand retained_output_recipe, seed real scoped ToolOutputStore, provide normal bounded head/tail preview and its fresh actual handle. Before inference verify decisive rows are omitted inline but authorized read can recover them. Record recovered bytes/calls separately; a correct code answer alone does not prove causal use.
model_visible_projection.resumed_plans: Seed durable_todo_state through host-owned journal state, use resume_summary for prose, and obtain final host-plan receipt via strict branch replay. The agent cannot edit the receipt or source of truth directly.
model_visible_projection.comfortable_window_control: No added padding, hidden prior history, compaction requirement or plan. Record actual pressure; do not force every task into the same pressure cohort.

offline_to_live_admission_gates: Frozen positive and targeted negative oracle controls pass.
All future task constraints are actually available in permitted original history or scoped recovery; no impossible hidden-fact tasks.
A host adapter constructs valid transcript pairs and real output/plan state without exposing controls or oracle code.
Verifier executes after the turn in a separate protected environment; current Python -I control runner is not that sandbox.
Publish a new resolved manifest with user-approved spend, exact model, one intervention, immutable harness/settings, and practical adoption criterion before any inference.

For resumed_plans, validate host-observed mutation event history: no checkpoint add/delete/replace operations, including operations whose effects are later reversed; final state alone is insufficient.

outcomes.primary: All task-specific executable assertions pass, with no safety/authority violation. Resumed plan requires both code behavior and host-observed plan continuity.
separate_fields: task oracle status and failing assertion
total monetary cost per attempted task
do_not_use: estimated prompt characters as billed tokens

stop_criteria: No inference until authorization fields and admission gates are satisfied.
Stop immediately on authority/credential/data isolation violation or hard spend/resource limit.
Stop if an oracle becomes model-visible or a host receipt becomes model-editable; invalidate affected pair.
Stop and diagnose irreconcilable usage/accounting or adapter failures; retain failures in the record and do not silently replace them.
If results are inconclusive or there are too few discordant pairs, retain current defaults; expansion requires new authorization.
analysis: Report each paired outcome and raw discordances by task/pressure stratum, including failed attempts. This tiny purpose-built corpus checks feasibility and failure mechanisms; it cannot establish general Astra-medium efficacy or justify rollout alone.
next_revision_rule: This manifest freezes the offline design and source hashes. Resolving any pending model/budget/intervention/harness field requires a new explicitly approved manifest revision; do not mutate it silently.
revision_reason: Independent review found valid QUOTE_ALL CSV falsely rejected by exact empty-header encoding. Empty header now uses CSV semantics plus LF framing; added an independent valid serialization control. No inference authorization or pending model/intervention resolution changed.
